item.description:

Bambino’s Vallejo presents Comedy Club Comedy: a FREE night of clean, PG-13 stand-up with comics who’ve been seen on Dry Bar Comedy, Last Comic Standing, and major Bay Area clubs.
Most nights, a show like this is paid admission at a dedicated club. You plan the trip, pay for parking, and hope the food is decent. This time the club is coming to downtown Vallejo — and it’s free. LINEUP: Host — Big Swiss, Opening — Big J Porter, Feature — Dan McGowan, Headliner — Stephan Boeringer. Clean. Funny. PG-13. The kind of night you can bring a date, friends, or family to without bracing for the next joke. Come early, grab pizza or pasta, and get a good seat. Comedy nights here fill up, and this one is built like a ticketed club show — except nobody’s charging at the door. Questions or a group coming in? Call Bambino’s at 707-562-2224

item.title: Liz Longley — Wed Oct 21, 7:00 PM — Brannan Center
item.description:
Best known for her stop-you-in-your-tracks voice, Liz Longley is an award-winning singer/songwriter based in Nashville. Her deeply emotional music has earned accolades from some of the most prestigious songwriting competitions in the country, including the BMI John Lennon Songwriting Scholarship.
The Berklee College of Music grad worked alongside 5-time Grammy-nominated producer, Paul Moak, on her much awaited sixth album, ‘Funeral For my Past’. The record was funded by a loyal fanbase on the Kickstarter platform, raising over $150,000. The remarkable fan support made Longley the \#4 most funded female musician in Kickstarter history. The story was covered by Billboard. Set to release in September 2020, the album will be Liz’s first release after her new found independence.
Source: North Bay Bohemian

item.title: Izaak Opatz — Thu Oct 22, 6:00 PM — Little Saint
item.description:
Like many of his favorite songwriters \(John Hartford, Lucinda Williams, Jeff Tweedy\),
Izaak Opatz is an ungulate in life’s winter pasture, chewing on and metabolizing
disappointment, heartbreak, and the other tough stuff into enjoyable musical
carbohydrates. A compulsive metaphorager \(and inveterate wordplayboy\), Opatz
breaks it all down with enzymes of wry humor, thoughtful simile and close observation -
a therapeutic process of narrativizing his own life that, almost as a byproduct, turns out
savory nuggets of literate, confessional pop.
Where 2018’s Mariachi Static drew from Opatz’s fragmented love life as a seasonal
Park Service employee and resonated especially with the sensitive dirtbag set, Extra
Medium, his latest release, splits time between romantic Hindenburgs across his native
Montana, up the East Coast, and in faraway Los Angeles. Montana and LA especially
decorate the album, supplying wells of metaphor and scene-making, and as characters
in their own right

item.description:
We meet in-person only on the 1st and 2nd Thursdays of the month. However, you can catch us online every Thursday unless the meeting date falls on a holiday.
Please register at https://signup.com/go/WiniixA
What is Toastmasters About?
Usually at our meetings, we will have a prepared speech, and a speech evaluation. The Grammarian and Wizard of Ah's will listen for turns of phrases and the use of filler words. We also practice impromptu speaking during the section of the meeting called Table Topics. During Table Topics, at a recent meeting, we were asked what we felt was the biggest communication problem or challenge. What would you answer in a fast moment? Table topics will challenge you to think quickly and give an answer without preparation.
You will also hear tips on public speaking skills at our upcoming meeting. Whether you're a seasoned traveler or just looking for some adventure from the comfort of your home, this event is perfect for you.

item.title: The Art of Broom Making — Sat Oct 24, 10:00 AM — Gather Sebastopol
item.description:
Join us for a hands-on workshop where tradition meets artistry. Alissa Kaplan, maker and founder of Zizland Atelier, will guide you through the craft of broom making as you create your own Wrapped Hawk Tail Whisk—a beautiful and functional hand broom with deep roots in American folk tradition.
In this 3-hour class, you’ll learn:
• A brief history and uses of hand brooms
• Traditional Shaker/Appalachian binding and wrapping techniques
• How to select and prepare broomcorn for a whisk
• Step-by-step guidance to craft your own wrapped Hawk Tail Whisk to take home

In this hands-on workshop, you’ll learn how to make fresh cheeses from cow and goat milk, while exploring how herbs, flowers, and citrus can shape flavor in simple, elegant ways. We’ll cover the essential techniques behind fresh cheesemaking so you can confidently recreate them in your own kitchen.
In this workshop you’ll:
• Learn the fundamentals of fresh cheesemaking using cow and goat milk
• Understand key concepts in cheesemaking, including acidity, texture, and food safety
• Make goat milk chèvre with edible flowers and with rosemary and honey
• Prepare fresh ricotta with Meyer lemon
• Explore how to incorporate herbs, flowers, and other botanicals into your cheeses

item.title: Phil Johnson and Roadside Attraction Comedy and Music — Sat Oct 24, 7:30 PM — Trek Winery
item.description:
Headlining!
Phil Johnson delivers a high-energy comedy experience that blends stand-up and live music. With a sharp eye for the absurd, he tackles topics like American exceptionalism, body image, conspiracy culture, and the general weirdness of modern life — all from the viewpoint of a guy who happily grew up in the deeply multi-everything community of the San Francisco Bay Area.
His material is smart, satirical, and unafraid to ask bigger questions while still chasing the laugh.
Phil has performed at the Sundance Film Festival and Edinburgh Fringe Festival, his stand-up tracks air on SiriusXM Radio, and he's been heard on Bob & Tom Radio and seen on Amazon Prime. He has released four comedy specials and multiple albums and singles, showcasing a signature blend of tightly written jokes, catchy \(and occasionally naughty\) songs, and a performer's instinct for balancing insight with irreverence.
